edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, CBS News reported “The FTC said last month that more consumers qualify for refunds from Amazon and also raised the maximum payment from $51 to $200.”; on the same day, The Hill reported “As part of the joint motion, the payment cap may adjust from $51 to $200.”.

On 2026-10-02, CBS News reported “The revised order requires Amazon to reimburse members who used up to 20 Prime benefits over a year and who signed up for Prime between June 23, 2019, and June 23, 2025.”; on the same day, The Hill reported “Either needs to have happened between June 23, 2019, and June 23, 2025.”.

On 2026-10-02, CBS News reported “As of September, Amazon had refunded more than $845 million to customers, with the company agreeing under the settlement to issue $1.5 billion in refunds and pay a $1 billion civil penalty.”; on the same day, The Hill reported “As of September, Amazon had distributed more than $845 million, but less than the $1.5 billion it was required to pay in redress.”.
